data.text:
[4:39PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Slow movement is being observed on CMS bridge inward Offin Canal market. This congestion is attributed to a high volume of vehicles and market activities, particularly the in-and-out vehicular flow at Offin Canal market. However, traffic flow improves immediately after the Offin Canal market stretch, becoming smooth towards Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection. 

Broad Street is experiencing slow and steady movement from its beginning stretch to Apongbon underneath the bridge, affecting connections to Offin Canal market, Olowogbowo, and the Offin Canal market area itself. This is also due to market activities and the evening rush hour.

 Conversely, Eko Bridge shows good movement by the NEPA intersection heading inward towards Apongbon. Traffic is also flowing well on the descending stretch of Eko Bridge towards CMS and the Elegbeta Mini stadium, as well as the Ebute Ero market area.

 Furthermore, the route from Ebute Ero market inward Leventist, via the UBA roundabout, and connecting to both inner and outer Marina, is currently clear. Personnel are present and actively managing the traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA

[4:51PM] #MobolajiBankAnthonyWay #TrafficUpdate 

 Traffic flow from Anthony towards Maryland en route to Odo Iyalaro is experiencing delays. However, movement improves from Maryland inward towards Leveltis, Nitel, and down to Sheraton. From Sheraton inward Customs and Ikeja proper, traffic is busy but moving due to commercial activities, with personnel on-site managing the flow.

 Similarly, traffic around Lasuth inward Kodesoh underneath the bridge is congested due to commercial activity, while the return journey from Kodesoh towards Lasuth is currently flowing well. Oba Akinjobi in Ikeja GRA has good movement inward the Police College, but the return journey from the Police College inward towards Lasuth underneath the bridge is currently busy, although moving, with personnel managing the situation. 

Mobolaji Bank Anthony Way towards Leveltis is clear, but congestion resumes from Leveltis onward towards Maryland. 
Our mem are present at various key points, ensuring ease of movement.
